contracts.boundary: Merge the current main branch into v2, preserving both ignore rules, main copyright attribution, v2 license link, main badge, main instruction updates, and the upstream test assertion correction. Product routing code is unchanged.
contracts.assertions: The merge commit has the current v2 and main tips as parents and merges cleanly with main. The targeted resolver tests check the upstream assertion and executable resolution. Diff checks confirm no conflict markers or whitespace defects.

boundaryTest.name: throws when explicit env is not executable

fault.exception: Conflict resolution only; no production routing behavior changes. The target test exercises a real non-executable temporary binary rather than an injected production fault.

contracts.boundary: Scan all non-merge commits introduced by the actual PR base-to-head range, and scan each new merge commit against its first parent. Preserve the configured Gitleaks rules and fail closed on scan errors.
contracts.assertions: With Gitleaks 8.24.3, executable controls detect a canary added and later removed on a side branch and one introduced only in a merge resolution, including when removed later. Controls do not report a historical base canary or its removal. The secret job runs these controls. Node test witnesses verify pinned external action references and a narrowly scoped secret allowlist.

boundaryTest.name: pins every external action reference to a full commit SHA

invariant.name: the secret allowlist is scoped to the generic API key rule and exact values

fault.exception: The executable scanner controls run in the secret job rather than the Node test-event runner. In a disposable copy, removing merge scanning made the named merge-resolution-only control fail.
